name: Abhay Chauhan
taglines: B.Tech CSE-AI student building full-stack projects
heroIntro: 2nd-year B.Tech CSE-AI student building practical tools with Python, Flask, and AI-integrated systems.
about: Ever since childhood, I've been the kind of person who wants to know how things work — that curiosity is what pulled me toward technology. Now a 2nd-year B.Tech CSE-AI student at NIET, Greater Noida, I enjoy building practical tools using Python and Flask, with a growing interest in automation and AI-integrated systems. I learn by building — taking ideas from concept to deployed product — and I'm currently focused on my studies while looking for internship opportunities to apply what I'm learning in a real-world setting, with the goal of stepping into a full-time role after graduation.

education.institution: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology (NIET)
